product_one_liner.value: Momentus Technologies provides venue and event management software for convention centers, stadiums, performing arts venues, universities and other event operators to manage bookings, operations and revenue.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage links to a pricing page, but its retrieved content did not establish whether it presents plans or only a contact form; the boolean is a schema-required placeholder.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 450+ employees; PitchBook lists 416, supporting the selected band.

hq_location.notes: PitchBook identifies Saint Louis, Missouri as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: This is the founding year of the business, not its January 2023 rebranding.

eng_blog.notes: A company blog exists, but its index and engineering authorship were not sufficiently examined to classify it. The boolean is a schema-required placeholder.

public_docs.notes: The public Elite help center contains numerous documentation categories, including booking, financials, integrations, administration and troubleshooting.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The eight listed openings include marketing, implementation, sales operations, customer success, professional services, account management and support; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No provider was established. The AI announcement does not name one, and the trust center returned no readable content; documentation, AI FAQ and subprocessor verification remain incomplete.

compliance_certs.notes: The company publicly states SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001:2022 certification. ISO/IEC 42001 is outside the five requested standards.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook reports seven financing rounds, $38.3 million total raised and a latest deal type of Debt - Acquisition, but does not disclose the latest round's date or amount. These required value fields are placeholders, not an assertion of no funding.

raised_18mo.notes: Outside investment is documented, but the most recent financing date was not established; activity during 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 cannot be determined. The boolean is a schema-required placeholder.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title appears among the eight current openings. Senior Account Manager and Sales Operations Analyst do not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 28, 2026 announcement launches Momentus Ticketing, an enterprise ticketing platform, within the 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists nine executives without appointment dates; no dated joining or departure announcement was verified. The boolean is a schema-required placeholder.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Sales Operations Analyst posting names Salesforce as the primary CRM platform and also names HubSpot and Gong.
